proposed_comments.title: Continue after an MSI validation error

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream call can throw before the existing failure list and later-target loops complete; a two-product focused test proves the proposed per-product catch continues to an independent uninstall failure.

actions.label: Post the MSI validation continuation suggestion
actions.note: Draft only. The focused mock proof covers continuation after one validation exception and preservation of a subsequent independent uninstall failure; it does not exercise a real MSI API, signature verification, process launch, registry or filesystem mutation, elevation, damaged registration, or overall cleanup correctness.
